aboutGame.title: What is Soul's Remnant?
paragraphs: Soul's Remnant is a free-to-play 2D platformer MMORPG developed and published by Chaomoon, with an emphasis on social gameplay and exploration.

Its advertised features include a classless skill system, character stats, equipment upgrades, quests, crafting and gathering, guilds, housing, player shops, dungeons, bosses, and a large world with secrets to discover.

items.question: What kind of game is Soul's Remnant?
items.answer: It is a free-to-play 2D platformer MMORPG focused on social play and exploration.

items.question: Does Soul's Remnant use fixed character classes?
items.answer: No. The official description highlights a classless system that lets players customize skills and character stats.

items.question: Who develops Soul's Remnant?
items.answer: Soul's Remnant is developed and published by the small indie team Chaomoon.

items.question: Where can I play Soul's Remnant?
items.answer: The game is available free to play through its official Steam store page.
